verses.original: δὲ πρωῒ Τῇ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων οὔσης ἔτι σκοτίας Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ ἔρχεται εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ βλέπει τὸν λίθον ἠρμένον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: de prōi Tē mia tōn sabbatōn ousēs eti skotias Maria hē Magdalēnē erchetai eis to mnēmeion kai blepei ton lithon ērmenon ek tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: - Early [on] the first [day] of the week while it was still dark Mary - Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the [entrance]

verses.original: οὖν ἔρχεται καὶ τρέχει πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄλλον μαθητὴν ὃν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐφίλει Ἦραν τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun erchetai kai trechei pros Simōna Petron kai pros ton allon mathētēn hon ho Iēsous ephilei Ēran ton Kyrion ek tou mnēmeiou kai legei autois kai ouk oidamen pou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: So she came - running to Simon Peter and - the other disciple the one whom - Jesus loved They have taken the Lord out of the tomb - she said - and vvv we do not know where they have put Him

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Πέτρος καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητής Ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἤρχοντο εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: oun ho Petros kai ho allos mathētēs Exēlthen kai ērchonto eis to mnēmeion
verses.literal: Then - Peter and the other disciple set out . . . . . . for the tomb

verses.original: δὲ οἱ δύο ἔτρεχον ὁμοῦ καὶ ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς προέδραμεν τάχιον τοῦ Πέτρου καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον πρῶτος
verses.transliteration: de hoi dyo etrechon homou kai ho allos mathētēs proedramen tachion tou Petrou kai ēlthen eis to mnēmeion prōtos
verses.literal: - The two were running together [but] the other disciple outran . . . - Peter and reached . . . the tomb first

verses.original: καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει τὰ ὀθόνια κείμενα μέντοι οὐ εἰσῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: kai parakypsas blepei ta othonia keimena mentoi ou eisēlthen
verses.literal: - He bent down [and] looked in at the linen cloths lying [there] but vvv he did not go in

verses.original: οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος Ἔρχεται καὶ ἀκολουθῶν αὐτῷ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ θεωρεῖ τὰ ὀθόνια κείμενα
verses.transliteration: oun Simōn Petros Erchetai kai akolouthōn autō kai eisēlthen eis to mnēmeion kai theōrei ta othonia keimena
verses.literal: - Simon Peter arrived just after him - He entered . . . the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying [there]

verses.original: καὶ τὸ σουδάριον ὃ ἦν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς ἐντετυλιγμένον ἀλλὰ κείμενον εἰς ἕνα τόπον χωρὶς οὐ μετὰ τῶν ὀθονίων
verses.transliteration: kai to soudarion ho ēn epi autou tēs kephalēs entetyligmenon alla keimenon eis hena topon chōris ou meta tōn othoniōn
verses.literal: - The cloth that had been around [Jesus’] - head was rolled up - lying vvv vvv separate . . . - from the linen cloths

verses.original: οὖν τότε ὁ ἄλλος μαθητὴς ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον πρῶτος καὶ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐπίστευσεν
verses.transliteration: oun tote ho allos mathētēs ho elthōn eis to mnēmeion prōtos kai eisēlthen kai eiden kai episteusen
verses.literal: Then . . . the other disciple who had reached . . . the tomb first also went in And he saw and believed

verses.original: γὰρ οὐδέπω ᾔδεισαν τὴν γραφὴν ὅτι αὐτὸν δεῖ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: gar oudepō ēdeisan tēn graphēn hoti auton dei anastēnai ek nekrōn
verses.literal: For vvv they still did not understand from the Scripture that [Jesus] had to rise from [the] dead

verses.original: οὖν οἱ μαθηταί Ἀπῆλθον πάλιν πρὸς αὑτοὺς
verses.transliteration: oun hoi mathētai Apēlthon palin pros hautous
verses.literal: Then the disciples returned . . . to their [homes]

verses.original: δὲ Μαρία εἱστήκει ἔξω πρὸς τῷ μνημείῳ κλαίουσα οὖν ὡς ἔκλαιεν παρέκυψεν εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: de Maria heistēkei exō pros tō mnēmeiō klaiousa oun hōs eklaien parekypsen eis to mnēmeion
verses.literal: But Mary stood outside - the tomb weeping [And] as she wept she bent down [to look] into the tomb

verses.original: καὶ θεωρεῖ δύο ἀγγέλους ἐν λευκοῖς καθεζομένους ὅπου τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἔκειτο ἕνα πρὸς τῇ κεφαλῇ καὶ ἕνα πρὸς τοῖς ποσίν
verses.transliteration: kai theōrei dyo angelous en leukois kathezomenous hopou to sōma tou Iēsou ekeito hena pros tē kephalē kai hena pros tois posin
verses.literal: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body - of Jesus had lain one at the head and [the other] at the feet

verses.original: Γύναι τί κλαίεις Καὶ ἐκεῖνοι λέγουσιν αὐτῇ Ὅτι Ἦραν μου τὸν Κύριόν Λέγει αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐκ οἶδα ποῦ ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Gynai ti klaieis Kai ekeinoi legousin autē Hoti Ēran mou ton Kyrion Legei autois kai ouk oida pou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: Woman why are you weeping - they asked - Because they have taken my - Lord {away} she said . . . and vvv I do not know where they have put Him

verses.original: εἰποῦσα Ταῦτα ἐστράφη εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ θεωρεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: eipousa Tauta estraphē eis ta opisō kai theōrei ton Iēsoun hestōta kai ouk ēdei hoti estin Iēsous
verses.literal: When she had said this she turned . . . - around and saw - Jesus standing [there] [But] vvv she did not recognize that it was Jesus

verses.original: Γύναι τί κλαίεις Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῇ τίνα ζητεῖς δοκοῦσα ὅτι ἐστιν ὁ κηπουρός Ἐκείνη λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε εἰ σὺ ἐβάστασας αὐτόν εἰπέ μοι ποῦ ἔθηκας αὐτόν κἀγὼ ἀρῶ αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Gynai ti klaieis Iēsous legei autē tina zēteis dokousa hoti estin ho kēpouros Ekeinē legei autō Kyrie ei sy ebastasas auton eipe moi pou ethēkas auton kagō arō auton
verses.literal: Woman why are you weeping Jesus asked - Whom are you seeking Thinking - He was the gardener she said . . . Sir if you have carried Him off . . . tell me where you have put Him and I will get Him . . .

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῇ Μαριάμ ἐκείνη Στραφεῖσα λέγει αὐτῷ Ἑβραϊστί Ραββουνι ὃ λέγεται Διδάσκαλε
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Legei autē Mariam ekeinē Strapheisa legei autō Hebraisti Rabbouni ho legetai Didaskale
verses.literal: Jesus said to her Mary She turned [and] said to Him in Hebrew Rabboni ( which means “Teacher” )

verses.original: Μή ἅπτου μου Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῇ γὰρ οὔπω ἀναβέβηκα πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα δὲ πορεύου πρὸς καὶ εἰπὲ αὐτοῖς μου τοὺς ἀδελφούς Ἀναβαίνω πρὸς μου τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ὑμῶν Πατέρα καὶ μου Θεόν καὶ ὑμῶν Θεὸν
verses.transliteration: Mē haptou mou Iēsous Legei autē gar oupō anabebēka pros ton Patera de poreuou pros kai eipe autois mou tous adelphous Anabainō pros mou ton Patera kai hymōn Patera kai mou Theon kai hymōn Theon
verses.literal: {Do} not cling to Me Jesus said - for vvv I have not yet ascended to the Father But go - and tell - My - brothers I am ascending to My - Father and your Father - to My God and your God

verses.original: Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ Ἔρχεται ἀγγέλλουσα τοῖς μαθηταῖς ὅτι Ἑώρακα τὸν Κύριον καὶ ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: Mariam hē Magdalēnē Erchetai angellousa tois mathētais hoti Heōraka ton Kyrion kai tauta eipen autē
verses.literal: Mary - Magdalene went and announced to the disciples - I have seen the Lord And [she told them] [what] He had said to her

verses.original: οὖν Οὔσης τῇ μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ σαββάτων τῇ ἐκείνῃ ὀψίας ὅπου οἱ μαθηταὶ ἦσαν καὶ τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν λέγει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: oun Ousēs tē mia hēmera sabbatōn tē ekeinē opsias hopou hoi mathētai ēsan kai tōn thyrōn kekleismenōn dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn ho Iēsous ēlthen kai estē eis to meson kai Eirēnē hymin legei autois
verses.literal: - It was the first day of [the] week [and that] very evening while the disciples were [together] with the doors locked for - fear of the Jews - Jesus came and stood vvv vvv among them - Peace [be] with you He said to them

verses.original: καὶ εἰπὼν τοῦτο ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν πλευρὰν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἐχάρησαν ἰδόντες τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: kai eipōn touto edeixen autois kai tas cheiras kai tēn pleuran oun hoi mathētai Echarēsan idontes ton Kyrion
verses.literal: [After] He had said this He showed them - His hands and His side - The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord

verses.original: οὖν πάλιν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν καθὼς ὁ Πατήρ ἀπέσταλκέν με κἀγὼ πέμπω ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: oun palin ho Iēsous Eipen autois Eirēnē hymin kathōs ho Patēr apestalken me kagō pempō hymas
verses.literal: - Again - Jesus said to them Peace [be] with you As the Father has sent Me . . . so also I am sending you

verses.original: καὶ εἰπὼν τοῦτο ἐνεφύσησεν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Λάβετε Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: kai eipōn touto enephysēsen kai legei autois Labete Hagion Pneuma
verses.literal: [When] He had said this He breathed on [them] and said . . . Receive [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: ἄν ἀφῆτε τινων τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἀφέωνται αὐτοῖς ἄν κρατῆτε τινων κεκράτηνται
verses.transliteration: an aphēte tinōn tas hamartias apheōntai autois an kratēte tinōn kekratēntai
verses.literal: If you forgive anyone his - sins they are forgiven . . . if you withhold [forgiveness] from anyone it is withheld

verses.original: δὲ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος εἷς ἐκ τῶν δώδεκα ἦν οὐκ μετ’ αὐτῶν ὅτε Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν
verses.transliteration: de Thōmas ho legomenos Didymos heis ek tōn dōdeka ēn ouk met’ autōn hote Iēsous ēlthen
verses.literal: Now Thomas - called Didymus one of the Twelve was not with [the disciples] when Jesus came

verses.original: οὖν οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταί ἔλεγον αὐτῷ Ἑωράκαμεν τὸν Κύριον δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐὰν μὴ ἴδω τὸν τῶν ἥλων τύπον ἐν αὐτοῦ ταῖς χερσὶν καὶ βάλω μου τὸν δάκτυλόν εἰς τὸν τύπον τῶν ἥλων καὶ βάλω μου τὴν χεῖρα εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν πλευρὰν οὐ μὴ πιστεύσω
verses.transliteration: oun hoi alloi mathētai elegon autō Heōrakamen ton Kyrion de Ho eipen autois Ean mē idō ton tōn hēlōn typon en autou tais chersin kai balō mou ton daktylon eis ton typon tōn hēlōn kai balō mou tēn cheira eis autou tēn pleuran ou mē pisteusō
verses.literal: So the other disciples told him We have seen the Lord But - he replied . . . Unless . . . I see the - nail marks in His - hands and put my - finger [where] the - - nails [have been] and put my - hand into His - side vvv vvv I will never believe

verses.original: Καὶ ὀκτὼ ἡμέρας μεθ’ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἦσαν πάλιν ἔσω τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων καὶ Θωμᾶς μετ’ αὐτῶν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔρχεται καὶ ἔστη εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ εἶπεν Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai oktō hēmeras meth’ autou hoi mathētai ēsan palin esō tōn thyrōn kekleismenōn kai Thōmas met’ autōn ho Iēsous erchetai kai estē eis to meson kai eipen Eirēnē hymin
verses.literal: - Eight days later His - disciples were once again inside [with] the doors locked and Thomas [was] with them - Jesus came and stood vvv vvv among them and said Peace [be] with you

verses.original: εἶτα λέγει τῷ Θωμᾷ Φέρε σου τὸν δάκτυλόν ὧδε καὶ ἴδε μου τὰς χεῖράς καὶ φέρε σου τὴν χεῖρά καὶ βάλε εἰς μου τὴν πλευράν καὶ γίνου μὴ ἄπιστος ἀλλὰ πιστός
verses.transliteration: eita legei tō Thōma Phere sou ton daktylon hōde kai ide mou tas cheiras kai phere sou tēn cheira kai bale eis mou tēn pleuran kai ginou mē apistos alla pistos
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said - to Thomas Put your - finger here and look at My - hands - Reach out your - hand and put [it] into My - side - vvv vvv Stop doubting and believe

verses.original: Θωμᾶς Ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ μου Ὁ Κύριός καὶ μου ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Thōmas Apekrithē kai eipen autō mou Ho Kyrios kai mou ho Theos
verses.literal: Thomas replied . . . . . . . . . My - Lord and my - God

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅτι ἑώρακάς με πεπίστευκας μακάριοι οἱ μὴ ἰδόντες καὶ πιστεύσαντες
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō Hoti heōrakas me pepisteukas makarioi hoi mē idontes kai pisteusantes
verses.literal: - Jesus said to him Because you have seen Me you have believed blessed [are] those who vvv have not seen and yet have believed

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐποίησεν Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἄλλα σημεῖα ἐνώπιον τῶν αὐτοῦ μαθητῶν ἃ ἔστιν οὐκ γεγραμμένα ἐν τούτῳ τῷ βιβλίῳ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous epoiēsen Polla men oun kai alla sēmeia enōpion tōn autou mathētōn ha estin ouk gegrammena en toutō tō bibliō
verses.literal: - Jesus performed many vvv vvv vvv other signs in the presence of His disciples which are not written in this - book

verses.original: δὲ ταῦτα γέγραπται ἵνα πιστεύητε ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἵνα πιστεύοντες ἔχητε ζωὴν ἐν αὐτοῦ τῷ ὀνόματι
verses.transliteration: de tauta gegraptai hina pisteuēte hoti Iēsous estin ho Christos ho Huios tou Theou kai hina pisteuontes echēte zōēn en autou tō onomati
verses.literal: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ the Son - of God and that by believing you may have life in His - name
